scope: Selected value fields from synthetic native prplMesh traffic; independent implementation cross-check, not normative complete-message vectors or EMOSA traffic
display_filter: frame.number == 1 || frame.number == 2 || frame.number == 5 || frame.number == 7 || frame.number == 20 || frame.number == 22
transformation: tshark -n -2 -T pdml; selected TLV values and dissector field interpretations only. Header boundaries come from dissector sizes; frame 7 uses its reassembled data source. No EMOSA module is imported.
review: Synthetic SSIDs and MAC identities already present in public native baseline; no WSC content or credentials projected. Reserved service 0xa1 retained for receiver tests, prohibited in encoder output under EasyMesh 6.1 section 3.1.2.
specification_refs: IEEE 802.11-2024 Table E-4, selected global operating classes, printed pages 5658-5659
EasyMesh 6.1 sections 17.2.6 Table 29 p.127, 17.2.48 Table 71 pp.157-158, 17.2.52 Table 75 p.160
feature_cross_check_limits: For 0xa1/0xb4/0xbe compare raw flags and numeric fields. Older dissectors omit new feature bits and use outdated semantic labels; EasyMesh 6.1 is authority for current meanings. No feature capability of EMOSA or a physical pod is inferred.
